title: Outputs show selected values
summary: An output exposes a useful result from the configuration. It does not automatically make a private value safe to publish.
introduction: An output exposes a useful result from the configuration. It does not automatically make a private value safe to publish. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: An output exposes a useful result from the configuration. It does not automatically make a private value safe to publish.
The output refers to the greeting resource from the earlier example. Its value becomes available after the local resource has state.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Name an output that describes a non-secret value clearly.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Marking an output sensitive hides some display, but does not remove it from state.
For more detail later, use this [Terraform further reading](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/tutorials).
